user.title: Connect to lemonfiber
user.description: Paste what the stack showed when the integration key was minted: its address, the key and the certificate pin. The operator password is never asked for.

data_description.url: The https address the mint reply gave, with its port.
data_description.api_key: The integration key, which starts with lfk_.
data_description.pin: The 64 hexadecimal characters that identify the stack's certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the key
reauth_confirm.description: The stack no longer admits the key {name} holds. Mint a new key on the stack and paste it here.

data_description.api_key: The new integration key, which starts with lfk_.

reconfigure.title: Change the address and pin
reconfigure.description: The key stays as it is. Give the address and certificate pin the stack is reached at now.

data_description.url: The https address the stack is served at now, with its port.
data_description.pin: The 64 hexadecimal characters that identify the stack's certificate.

error.address_refused: This is not an address lemonfiber is reached at. Give it as the mint reply wrote it: https, the machine's name or address, and the port.
error.address_not_https: A stack is reached over https, where its pin can be checked. Use the https address from the mint reply.
error.pin_malformed: A certificate pin is 64 hexadecimal characters. Copy it whole from the mint reply.
error.pin_mismatch: The stack presented a certificate other than the one this pin names, so nothing was sent. Check the pin, or whether the address reaches the right machine.
error.unreachable: Nothing answered at this address from here. If lemonfiber's web surface is bound to loopback only, a Home Assistant on another machine cannot reach it: bind it beyond loopback on the stack, then use the https address and pin it shows.
error.key_malformed: A key is written in visible characters with no spaces. Copy it whole from the mint reply.
error.key_refused: The stack does not admit this key. It may have been revoked; mint a new one.
error.key_in_the_clear: The stack refuses a key that arrives from another machine without the encryption its pin verifies. Use the https address and the pin from the mint reply.
error.not_lemonfiber: Something answered at this address, and it is not lemonfiber.
error.version_mismatch: This integration speaks version {spoken} of lemonfiber's interface and the stack speaks version {served}. Update whichever of the two is older.
error.no_dashboard: The stack answered but did not send its dashboard in time.

abort.reauth_successful: The new key is in use.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The new address and pin are in use.

address_refused.message: The stored address is not one lemonfiber is reached at. Change it in the integration's settings.

address_not_https.message: The stored address is not https. Change it in the integration's settings.

pin_malformed.message: The stored certificate pin is not 64 hexadecimal characters. Change it in the integration's settings.

pin_mismatch.message: The stack presented a certificate other than the pinned one, so nothing was sent. If the stack's certificate changed, give the new pin in the integration's settings.

unreachable.message: Nothing answered at the stack's address. Home Assistant tries again.

key_malformed.message: The stored key is not one a request can carry. Replace it.

key_refused.message: The stack does not admit the key. Replace it with a new one.

key_in_the_clear.message: The stack refuses a key that arrives without the encryption its pin verifies. Use the https address and pin.

not_lemonfiber.message: Something other than lemonfiber answered at the stack's address.

version_mismatch.message: This integration speaks version {spoken} of lemonfiber's interface and the stack speaks version {served}. Update whichever of the two is older.

no_dashboard.message: The stack answered but did not send its dashboard in time. Home Assistant tries again.
